name: ugg-portal
description: UGG (UEM Gamerz Guild) Website with Backend & Admin Portal

scripts.build: cp backend/data/content.json react-version/public/content.json 2>/dev/null || true; npm run build --prefix react-version && cp react-version/dist/index.html ./index.html && cp react-version/dist/index.html ./404.html && cp backend/data/content.json ./content.json 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r react-version/dist/assets ./ && cp -r react-version/dist/uploads ./ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix react-version

author: Soumyadeep Roy
